title: Card 4: Redis ki copy taiyaar. Copy bhi gayi to pehle se tay: login band, feed khula

boxes.title: Gateway
lines: har request pe Redis se poochta

boxes.title: Endpoint ke hisaab se
lines: tab tak gateway apni memory me ginta

callouts.red: Redis ne jawab hi nahi diya. Gira hai, pata kaise chale?
callouts.green: Chhota timeout (~5 ms). Itne me jawab nahi aaya to gira maano, ruko mat
Copy primary ban jaati (Redis Cluster). Beech ke kuch second ki ginti gayi, chalta hai

callouts.red: Copy bhi gayi, dono Redis band
callouts.green: Pehle se tay hai (upar wala dabba): login band, user ko 503. Feed khula, tab tak gateway apni ginti
Login bhi khul jaata: koi bhi bina had Arpan ka password try karta

callouts.red: Redis gira nahi, bas CPU full tha. Copy laga doon? Nahi: ginti badhana = likhna, aur likhna sirf primary pe hota.
callouts.green: Isliye tukde (shard): har user ki ginti alag Redis machine pe

kyun: Redis ki copy pehle se taiyaar rehti. Dono gire to kya karna hai, ye pehle se likha hai: login jaisi cheez band (fail-closed), feed jaisi khuli (fail-open)
peeche: card 3 me limiter sabse aage, API Gateway pe
ab: Dopahar Redis gira, limiter andha ho gaya, Arpan ke login pe koi had nahi
agla: ab ek region me sab theek. Par Arpan kai region se aaye to? (card 5)
